## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 Claude API Key / Bearer 连接卡片仍显示“等待 Anthropic 适配器验证”的误导提示。已完成配置的连接现在明确显示用量查询尚未接入；仍未验证的凭据类型继续保留待适配器验证状态。
- Claude API 连接详情不再显示 Codex 专用的默认速度字段，避免把 Fast / 服务等级语义带入 Claude Code。
- 保留 Claude 订阅 OAuth、账号代次隔离、订阅刷新失败状态，以及 Claude Desktop 多实例隔离未验证时的 blocked 边界。

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和兼容 Anthropic Messages 网关连接；客户端需单独安装。Claude 订阅 OAuth 用于独立账号身份和用量摘要。Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）仍未接入受管实例，因为当前官方构建忽略独立 profile，无法证明多实例隔离。云模式、npm 包装启动器和其他云厂商凭据仍未验证。Claude 模型由连接明确声明，会话管理当前只读。

Codex desktop / CLI and the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS are supported. Claude connections use API Keys, Bearer tokens or gateways compatible with Anthropic Messages. Claude subscription OAuth is available for isolated account identity and usage summaries. Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) remains blocked for managed instances because the current official build ignores independent profiles, so multi-instance isolation cannot be established. Cloud modes, npm wrapper launchers and other cloud-provider credentials remain unverified. Claude models must be declared by the connection, and session management remains read-only.

## 验证来源 / Verification

本版本完成 `npm run typecheck`、`npm run test:ci`（1214 项通过，4 项条件跳过）、`npm run test:claude-code`（121 项通过）、Go sidecar 测试、Electron 源码构建，以及真实 Electron Claude 管理器 UI 烟测。UI 烟测只使用合成账号、凭据和会话，不访问网络、不启动真实 Claude 客户端，也不代表真实 Anthropic 订阅鉴权。匹配版本标签、来源提交、GitHub Actions 构建记录、安装包和 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 由本版本 Release 流程关联提供。

This release completed `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:ci` (1214 passed, 4 conditional skips), `npm run test:claude-code` (121 passed), Go sidecar tests, the Electron source build, and a real Electron Claude manager UI smoke test. The UI smoke test uses synthetic accounts, credentials and transcripts only; it makes no network requests and launches no real Claude client, so it does not establish real Anthropic subscription authentication. The matching version tag, source commit, GitHub Actions build record, installers and `SHA256SUMS.txt` are attached by this release workflow.
